test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the option exactly similar to: 16th Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bangalore, KA 560001

options.text: 16th Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bengalooru, KA-560001
16 Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bangalore, KA 560001
16th Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bangalore, KA 560001
16th Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bangalore, Karnataka 560001

solution:
**Options**
 **Original Address**
 **Difference**
 
 

 (1)

 16th Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bengalooru, KA-560001
 **16th Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bangalore, KA 560001**
 Spelling of "Bangalore" changed to "Bengalooru" and hyphen used in PIN code.
 
 

 (2)

 16 Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bangalore, KA 560001
 **16th Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bangalore, KA 560001**
 "16th" written as "16" (missing ordinal indicator).
 
 

 (3)

 16th Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bangalore, KA 560001
 **16th Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bangalore, KA 560001**
 **This address is exactly the same as the given address.**
 
 

 (4)

 16th Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bangalore, Karnataka 560001
 **16th Floor, Alpha Tower, Near City Center Mall, Bangalore, KA 560001**
 "KA" written as "Karnataka".
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
